note: Run against the live contract with throwaway buyer, attacker and gateway accounts. Because the gateway account was not registered, a successful metered consumption was not possible in this run; the success path (finalized consumption -> data, and exactly one of two concurrent requests served) is NOT covered here. The two FAIL entries are a gateway bug found by this run: an RPC error text with line breaks was put into a response header, so the gateway answered 500 (no data was released). That is fixed (reasons are made header-safe, see tests/gateway.test.mjs) but has not been re-run live: Studio's public RPC answered 'Rate limit exceeded: 30 requests per minute' near the end of this run, and the run was not repeated. The paywall request near the end was served while the catalogue read was rate-limited and the gateway fell back to its local listing mirror; that fallback has since been removed for contract mode.
